description: This file defines classes and methods for managing circle data layers on a map, including creation, updating, styling, and interaction with Leaflet map layers within the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TbCircleDataLayerItem
classes.description: Represents a circle item on the map with capabilities for styling, editing, and interaction.

classes.name: TbCirclesDataLayer
classes.description: Manages a collection of circle data layer items, including creation, placement, and data persistence.

methods.name: isEditing
methods.description: Returns whether the circle item is currently being edited.

methods.name: updateBubblingMouseEvents
methods.description: Updates the bubbling mouse events option for the circle.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the circle item from the map and releases associated resources.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a Leaflet circle layer based on data and applies styles.

methods.name: unbindLabel
methods.description: Unbinds tooltip label from the circle.

methods.name: bindLabel
methods.description: Binds a tooltip label to the circle.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates the circle's style, tooltip, and label based on new data.

methods.name: doInvalidateCoordinates
methods.description: Invalidates and updates the circle's coordinates.

methods.name: addItemClass
methods.description: Adds a CSS class to the circle's DOM element.

methods.name: removeItemClass
methods.description: Removes a CSS class from the circle's DOM element.

methods.name: enableDrag
methods.description: Enables dragging of the circle for editing.

methods.name: disableDrag
methods.description: Disables dragging of the circle.

methods.name: onSelected
methods.description: Handles actions when the circle is selected for editing.

methods.name: onDeselected
methods.description: Handles actions when the circle is deselected.

methods.name: removeDataItemTitle
methods.description: Returns the localized title for removing the circle data item.

methods.name: removeDataItem
methods.description: Removes the circle data item from the data layer.

methods.name: saveCircleCoordinates
methods.description: Saves the current circle's center and radius to the data layer.

methods.name: updateCircleShape
methods.description: Updates the circle's position and size based on data.

methods.name: dataLayerType
methods.description: Returns the type of data layer ('circles').

methods.name: placeItem
methods.description: Places a circle item on the map layer.

methods.name: extractCircleCoordinates
methods.description: Extracts circle coordinates from data.

methods.name: saveCircleCoordinates
methods.description: Saves circle coordinates to the data source.

methods.name: getDataKeys
methods.description: Returns data keys used by the layer.

methods.name: defaultBaseSettings
methods.description: Provides default settings for the data layer.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Performs setup operations for the data layer.

methods.name: isValidLayerData
methods.description: Validates layer data.

methods.name: createLayerItem
methods.description: Creates a new layer item instance.
